topic.title: Collaborative Recommendation from Sparse Feedback
topic.overview: Recommendation learns which items suit which users from incomplete interactions, comparisons, or activity sequences. Shared latent structure lets information from one person help another, but observed behavior is sparse and shaped by what the system previously exposed. The topic includes both statistical analysis and practical representation design.
topic.whyItMatters: Personalization requires learning without repeatedly showing unhelpful items. Synthetic interactions and language models can add information, but may also reinforce existing beliefs unless quality and exposure effects are controlled.
topic.evolution: Early titles concern collaborative filtering; a 2014 model analyzes user-type exploration and nonrepeatable recommendations. Recent work studies sparse pairwise comparisons, open-world representations, and recursive generation of training sequences. The examples broaden feedback and augmentation mechanisms while retaining the core difficulty of inferring preferences from selective observations.
openQuestions: How can synthetic feedback improve coverage without amplifying popularity bias?
Which evaluations distinguish genuine preference learning from reproducing the exposure policy?

papers.title: Density-based User Representation using Gaussian Process Regression for Multi-interest Personalized Retrieval
papers.tldr: GPR4DUR represents user interests as uncertainty-aware densities to support flexible personalized retrieval and exploration.

papers.title: End-to-end Learnable Clustering for Intent Learning in Recommendation
papers.tldr: ELCRec jointly learns user behavior representations and intent clusters, improving recommendation performance and reducing computational costs in reported experiments.

papers.title: Evidential Stochastic Differential Equations for Time-Aware Sequential Recommendation
papers.tldr: E-NSDE models continuously changing user interests and links prediction uncertainty to the time between interactions.

papers.title: Fine-Grained Dynamic Framework for Bias-Variance Joint Optimization on Data Missing Not at Random
papers.tldr: The framework selects estimators for individual user-item pairs to jointly control bias and variance when observations are missing nonrandomly.

papers.title: Fine Tuning Out-of-Vocabulary Item Recommendation with User Sequence Imagination
papers.tldr: USIM uses imagined user sequences to refine content-derived item embeddings and improve recommendations for out-of-vocabulary items.

papers.title: Generalization Error Bounds for Two-stage Recommender Systems with Tree Structure
papers.tldr: Generalization bounds and experiments suggest that greater tree branching and better distribution alignment can improve two-stage recommenders.

papers.title: How Does Message Passing Improve Collaborative Filtering?
papers.tldr: TAG-CF turns findings about message passing into a single inference-time aggregation step that improves collaborative filtering at low computational cost.

papers.title: HYDRA: Model Factorization Framework for Black-Box LLM Personalization
papers.tldr: HYDRA personalizes black-box LLM outputs using history reranking and adapters that combine shared bases with user-specific heads.

papers.title: Identify Then Recommend: Towards Unsupervised Group Recommendation
papers.tldr: ITR discovers user groups without a preset group count and trains recommendations through self-supervised tasks.

papers.title: LLM-ESR: Large Language Models Enhancement for Long-tailed Sequential Recommendation
papers.tldr: LLM-ESR enhances sparse sequential recommendation with language-model semantics and information from similar users without extra inference load.

papers.title: On Softmax Direct Preference Optimization for Recommendation
papers.tldr: Softmax-DPO trains language-model recommenders with multiple negative items to incorporate ranking information and improve recommendation performance.

papers.title: Preference Learning of Latent Decision Utilities with a Human-like Model of Preferential Choice
papers.tldr: A tractable surrogate for a richer cognitive choice model improves preference inference and simulated decision utility.

papers.title: PSL: Rethinking and Improving Softmax Loss from Pairwise Perspective for Recommendation
papers.tldr: PSL replaces softmax's exponential function with suitable alternatives to improve ranking alignment and robustness to false negatives.

papers.title: Unveiling User Satisfaction and Creator Productivity Trade-Offs in Recommendation Platforms
papers.tldr: The paper identifies a trade-off between immediate recommendation satisfaction and creator productivity, then optimizes exploration to balance them.

papers.title: User-Creator Feature Polarization in Recommender Systems with Dual Influence
papers.tldr: A model of mutual user and creator adaptation predicts polarization and shows that relevance-focused recommendations can sometimes preserve diversity.

papers.title: A Geometric Approach to Personalized Recommendation with Set-Theoretic Constraints Using Box Embeddings
papers.tldr: Representing users and attributes as boxes enables personalized recommendations with explicit combinations and exclusions, with reported improvements over vector-based methods.

papers.title: ActionPiece: Contextually Tokenizing Action Sequences for Generative Recommendation
papers.tldr: ActionPiece builds recommendation tokens from feature patterns within and across actions so tokenization can reflect sequence context.

papers.title: From Feature Interaction to Feature Generation: A Generative Paradigm of CTR Prediction Models
papers.tldr: SFG improves click prediction by training models to generate feature embeddings using click supervision, reducing reported representation collapse and redundancy.

papers.title: Improving LLMs for Recommendation with Out-Of-Vocabulary Tokens
papers.tldr: Interaction-based out-of-vocabulary tokens give language models more effective user and item representations for recommendation.

papers.title: Learning Cascade Ranking as One Network
papers.tldr: LCRON trains ranking cascades end to end using losses tied to the probability of retaining ground-truth items.

papers.title: MTSTRec: Multimodal Time-Aligned Shared Token Recommender
papers.tldr: MTSTRec aligns product modalities within browsing sequences using a shared token, improving sequential recommendation benchmarks.

papers.title: Optimizing Social Network Interventions via Hypergradient-Based Recommender System Design
papers.tldr: A gradient-based method optimizes social interaction weights under Friedkin-Johnsen opinion dynamics, improving speed and disagreement reduction on large intervention problems.

papers.title: Pareto Merging: Multi-Objective Optimization for Preference-Aware Model Merging
papers.tldr: Pareto Merging produces a preference-dependent set of merged models in one process, allowing users to choose among task-performance trade-offs.

papers.title: Recommendations with Sparse Comparison Data: Provably Fast Convergence for Nonconvex Matrix Factorization
papers.tldr: Under a latent-feature choice model and warm-start condition, gradient methods rapidly learn personalized preferences from sparse pairwise comparisons.

papers.title: Unbiased Recommender Learning from Implicit Feedback via Weakly Supervised Learning
papers.tldr: PURL learns recommendations without negative samples, with unbiasedness conditional on accurate class-prior estimation using its proposed transport method.

papers.title: Can LLMs Outshine Conventional Recommenders? A Comparative Evaluation
papers.tldr: LLM recommenders achieve substantial quality gains in the benchmark, but their slow inference makes the evaluated approach impractical for real-time recommendations.

papers.title: Counterfactual Implicit Feedback Modeling
papers.tldr: Counter-IF estimates whether users would click items if exposed to them, accounting for uncertain exposure and ambiguous missing interactions.

papers.title: Fading to Grow: Growing Preference Ratios via Preference Fading Discrete Diffusion for Recommendation
papers.tldr: PreferGrow uses discrete preference fading and reconstruction to improve recommendation from sparse user data.

papers.title: Generalized Top-k Mallows Model for Ranked Choices
papers.tldr: The paper develops sampling, prediction, and active learning algorithms for buyer-choice models based on limited top-k rankings.

papers.title: Generalizing while preserving monotonicity in comparison-based preference learning models
papers.tldr: The paper gives sufficient embedding conditions for preference models that generalize to uncompared alternatives while preserving monotone responses to comparisons.

papers.title: How Does Topology Bias Distort Message Passing in Graph Recommender? A Dirichlet Energy Perspective
papers.tldr: The paper explains how graph message passing amplifies popularity bias and introduces richer inference-time propagation to improve long-tail recommendations.

papers.title: HPSERec: A Hierarchical Partitioning and Stepwise Enhancement Framework for Long-tailed Sequential Recommendation
papers.tldr: HPSERec improves long-tail sequential recommendation through hierarchical experts, progressive knowledge transfer, and optimal-transport alignment.

papers.title: Language Ranker: A Lightweight Ranking framework for LLM Decoding
papers.tldr: Language Ranker reranks responses using base-model features, matching large reward models on evaluated tasks with fewer than 500,000 added parameters.

papers.title: Listwise Preference Diffusion Optimization for User Behavior Trajectories Prediction
papers.tldr: LPDO trains diffusion models on preferences over entire action sequences to improve multi-step user-behavior prediction.

papers.title: MTRec: Learning to Align with User Preferences via Mental Reward Models
papers.tldr: MTRec learns an inferred satisfaction reward from user behavior to guide recommendations beyond raw click feedback.

papers.title: Negative Feedback Really Matters: Signed Dual-Channel Graph Contrastive Learning Framework for Recommendation
papers.tldr: SDCGCL learns from positive and negative feedback in coordinated graph channels, improving recommendation performance across four public datasets.

papers.title: On Efficiency-Effectiveness Trade-off of Diffusion-based Recommenders
papers.tldr: TA-Rec combines denoising consistency and adaptive preference alignment to achieve effective one-step diffusion-based recommendation.

papers.title: ORBIT - Open Recommendation Benchmark for Reproducible Research with Hidden Tests
papers.tldr: ORBIT combines reproducible recommendation benchmarks with a hidden webpage recommendation test that reveals generalization challenges.

papers.title: R$^2$ec: Towards Large Recommender Models with Reasoning
papers.tldr: R²ec jointly trains reasoning and recommendation in a dual-head model, improving tested recommendation performance with competitive inference efficiency.

papers.title: Semantic Retrieval Augmented Contrastive Learning for Sequential Recommendation
papers.tldr: SRA-CL combines language-model semantic retrieval with a learned sample synthesizer to improve contrastive training for sequential recommendation.

papers.title: Sparse Meets Dense: Unified Generative Recommendations with Cascaded Sparse-Dense Representations
papers.tldr: COBRA generates sparse item identifiers and conditioned dense vectors together, improving recommendation quality in offline and large-scale online evaluations.

papers.title: SPOT-Trip: Dual-Preference Driven Out-of-Town Trip Recommendation
papers.tldr: SPOT-Trip combines knowledge-graph-based stable preferences with continuously evolving interests to improve out-of-town itinerary recommendations.

papers.title: Think before Recommendation: Autonomous Reasoning-enhanced Recommender
papers.tldr: RecZero trains a single language model to reason before predicting ratings, while RecOne combines initial supervised reasoning training with reinforcement learning.

papers.title: TranSUN: A Preemptive Paradigm to Eradicate Retransformation Bias Intrinsically from Regression Models in Recommender Systems
papers.tldr: TranSUN learns to eliminate retransformation bias within recommendation regression models, with theoretical unbiasedness and reported industrial deployment.

papers.title: Tree of Preferences for Diversified Recommendation
papers.tldr: Tree of Preferences uses language models to infer underexplored interests and generate training interactions for more diverse, relevant recommendations.

papers.title: VisualLens: Personalization through Task-Agnostic Visual History
papers.tldr: VisualLens builds preference profiles from everyday images, improving recommendations on two benchmarks without requiring task-specific visual histories.

papers.title: Who You Are Matters: Bridging Interests and Social Roles via LLM-Enhanced Logic Recommendation
papers.tldr: TagCF uses language models to connect user roles and item topics through logic graphs, improving recommendations in online and offline experiments.

papers.title: An Efficient Joint Learning Approach for Item Response Theory
papers.tldr: An expectation-maximization method jointly estimates user ability and item difficulty, with theoretical support and reported gains over existing approaches.

papers.title: Beyond Single Embedding: Modeling User Preferences as Distribution in Federated Recommendation
papers.tldr: A diffusion-based recommender models each user with multiple plausible embeddings and aggregates their predictions to improve ranking stability.

papers.title: Can Recommender Systems Teach Themselves? A Recursive Self-Improving Framework with Fidelity Control
papers.tldr: RSIR improves recommendation models through repeated generation, preference-consistency filtering, and training on enriched interaction data.

papers.title: CARE: Adaptive Calibration for Reliable Recommendations
papers.tldr: CARE adapts recommendation-set calibration as behavior changes, combining compact outputs with finite-sample utility-risk guarantees.

papers.title: Causal Direct Preference Optimization for Distributionally Robust Generative Recommendation
papers.tldr: CausalDPO adds environmental adjustment and invariance constraints to preference optimization to improve recommendation robustness under distribution shifts.

papers.title: Cold-Start Personalization via Bayesian Adaptive Questioning
papers.tldr: CAPE combines learned preference correlations with online Bayesian questioning to personalize LLM systems with fewer interactions.

papers.title: CRAMER: Control via Request-Aware Masking for Editing Recommenders
papers.tldr: CRAMER uses natural-language requests to mask a frozen recommender's parameters, enabling immediate adaptation with minimal reported overhead.

papers.title: Differentially Private Cross-Silo Recommendation from Implicit Feedback
papers.tldr: DPIMF adapts private matrix factorization to sparse behavioral feedback, improving the measured privacy–utility trade-off in cross-silo recommendation.

papers.title: Eating for a Sustainable Planet: Personalized Sustainable Diet Recommendation via Constraint-Aware Decision-Making Modeling
papers.tldr: A personalized recipe recommender incorporates sustainability as learnable constraints and improves sustainable choices while preserving evaluated user preferences.

papers.title: Improving LLM-Based Recommenders with Conservative Generative Flow Networks
papers.tldr: CFlower constrains offline GFlowNet recommendation learning to logged-data support, improving distributional matching and the accuracy–exposure trade-off.

papers.title: Negative Sampling From the Ground Up: A Redesign for Recommendations
papers.tldr: The paper derives recommendation negative-sampling strategies from an underlying distribution and learning objective, analyzing both unbiased and partially observed biased graphs.

papers.title: Obliviate: Efficient Unlearning in Recommender Systems
papers.tldr: Obliviate uses localized adapters and calibration to forget recommendation interactions with little quality loss and reduced computation.

papers.title: Rethinking Contrastive Learning for Graph Collaborative Filtering: Limitations and a Simple Remedy
papers.tldr: NT-SSM improves graph recommendations by tailoring contrastive weight updates to different types of useful neighbor pairs.
